description:
Amazon Robotics is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

If you're passionate about actuation and robotics systems, and have a strong interest in safety and performance, then we'd like to talk to you about becoming part of an organization with global impact on millions of customer

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement and maintain embedded firmware for motor control and actuation systems, and contribute to the architecture of complex control systems alongside senior engineers and adjacent teams.
- Own the firmware features and modules you deliver across the development lifecycle, from design through integration, testing and field deployment.
- Support the gathering of functional and safety requirements, and turn them into robust, testable firmware implementations.
- Take part in system bring-up, debugging and root cause analysis, working systematically to fix issues at the source rather than the symptom.
- Give and take constructive feedback in design and code reviews, and communicate status, risks and findings clearly to the team.
- Build solutions that balance performance and reliability, and keep improving code quality, test coverage and documentation.
- Write automated tests and contribute to continuous integration to validate new features.
- Support system commissioning and field deployment, helping ensure results hold up in real-world conditions.

A day in the life
As a Firmware Engineer, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, build, test and debug cutting-edge robotic systems. You will own the firmware features you deliver, from early design to live field deployment. No two days look the same, and every one moves fast. You contribute ideas in design discussions, work with senior engineers to tackle hard problems in robotics, and turn product concepts into firmware that ships. You act with urgency and sound judgment without compromising quality or safety. When it's time to prove the work, you write automated tests to validate new features and run live testing to debug and find the root cause of issues. You stay accountable until the system performs and holds up under real-world conditions. You take initiative: you see what needs to happen and help make it happen.
- 5+ years of embedded firmware development experience
- Proficiency in C/C++ development for resource-constrained embedded systems
- Hands-on experience with ARM-based microcontrollers and processor peripherals (timers, PWM, ADC), and standard interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN)
- Experience developing on a real-time operating system such as FreeRTOS
- Working knowledge of Field-Oriented Control (FOC) and motor control fundamentals
- Ability to read schematics and work closely with hardware engineers during bring-up and debugging
- Experience with the full embedded software development lifecycle (requirements, design, implementation, testing, integration)
- Solid working knowledge of IEC 61508 (Functional Safety of Electrical/Electronic Systems), with a practical grasp of Safety Integrity Levels (SIL) and the full safety lifecycle.
- A firm foundation in cybersecurity principles and standards for embedded systems.
- Working knowledge of bootloaders and firmware update mechanisms.
- Practical familiarity with robotic control systems architecture.
- Applied experience with model-based development and code generation (MATLAB/Simulink).
- Hands-on exposure to continuous integration and automated testing.
